gloss: to be careful, to pay attention

definitions.gloss: to be careful, to pay attention, to watch out
definitions.explanation: To exercise caution or be mindful of something.

examples.japanese: ごめんなさい、⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}かった→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。これ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{気|き}をつけます。
examples.english: I'm sorry, it was my fault. I'll be more careful from now on.

examples.japanese: ⟦{足元|あしもと}→足元：00647_ashimoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気|き}をつけて⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気|き}をつけて⟦ね→ね：00348_ne⟧。

notes:
{気|き}をつける is a common expression meaning "to be careful."

GRAMMAR:
- Conjugates as ichidan verb: {気|き}をつけて (te-form), {気|き}をつけます (polite)
- Often followed by ⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧ as a polite request

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [noun]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気|き}をつける: to be careful of [noun]
- {気|き}をつけて: Take care! (parting phrase)

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{注意|ちゅうい}する→注意する：00693_chuui⟧: to pay attention, to warn
- ⟦{用心|ようじん}する→用心する：00730_youjin⟧: to be cautious
